top_signals.title: Why Tech’s AI Borrowing Binge Is Rattling Markets
top_signals.summary: The market for credit-default swaps, financial instruments that function much like insurance policies for Wall Street’s debt trades, rarely attracts attention when everything is going well. But when the cost of insuring a company’s debt starts climbing, more often than not it’s a warning that concerns are building beneath the surface.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Potential liquidity or banking-system instability affecting financial conditions.
